questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.

A) Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
B) Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
C) Only after the rain had stopped did they began the journey.
D) Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped did they began the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?

A) It was John who broke the window yesterday.
B) It was yesterday that John broke the window.
C) That John broke the window was the most surprising thing.
D) John, not Mary, broke the window yesterday.
options: It was John who broke the window yesterday.
It was yesterday that John broke the window.
That John broke the window was the most surprising thing.
John, not Mary, broke the window yesterday.
questions.answer: It was John who broke the window yesterday.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical or unlikely situation.

A) If I were you, I would accept the offer.
B) If I was you, I would accept the offer.
C) If I had been you, I would accept the offer.
D) If I had been you, I should accept the offer.
options: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If I was you, I would accept the offer.
If I had been you, I would accept the offer.
If I had been you, I should accept the offer.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses ellipsis to omit the redundant part while maintaining grammatical integrity.

A) She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his brother.
B) She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his.
C) She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his brother.
D) She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his own brother.
options: She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his.
She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his own brother.
questions.answer: She is taller than her sister, but he is taller than his.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences demonstrates correct usage of formal register with complex sentence structure?

A) The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable, but they required further consultation.
B) The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable, however they required further consultation.
C) The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable; moreover, they required further consultation.
D) The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable, furthermore, they required further consultation.
options: The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable, but they required further consultation.
The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable, however they required further consultation.
The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable; moreover, they required further consultation.
The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable, furthermore, they required further consultation.
questions.answer: The committee decided that the proposal was acceptable; moreover, they required further consultation.
